About the Scarlet & Violet era

Scarlet & Violet brought back Pokémon ex and introduced Illustration Rares and Special Illustration Rares, known as Art Rares and Special Art Rares in Japanese sets.

Our Scarlet & Violet cards currently come from Terastal Festival ex, Battle Partners and Super Electric Breaker. See every Scarlet & Violet set, in release order, in our Pokémon TCG sets guide.
